description: Manages the dynamic GATT table (creates and removes services and characteristics at runtime), applies the changes, and reads the connection status and transfer parameters.

commands.label: Create GATT service
commands.description: Registers a new GATT service with the given 16-bit UUID.

fields.label: Service UUID
fields.description: 16-bit GATT service UUID

fields.label: Primary service
fields.description: 1 = primary service, 0 = secondary

commands.label: Remove GATT service
commands.description: Removes the GATT service with the given UUID, unless it is locked.

fields.label: Service UUID
fields.description: 16-bit UUID of the service to remove

commands.label: Create GATT characteristic
commands.description: Adds a characteristic to a GATT service, with its permissions, buffers and text description.

fields.label: Parent service UUID
fields.description: 16-bit UUID of the parent service

fields.label: Characteristic UUID
fields.description: 16-bit GATT characteristic UUID

fields.label: Write
fields.description: 1 = the client may write

fields.label: Indicate
fields.description: 1 = send with acknowledgement (indication)

fields.label: Notify
fields.description: 1 = send without acknowledgement (notification)

fields.label: Framed
fields.description: 1 = every packet starts with a fragment header (for frames longer than the MTU)

fields.label: TX buffer size
fields.description: TX buffer size in bytes (0 = no TX); only for a characteristic that notifies or indicates

fields.label: RX buffer size
fields.description: RX buffer size in bytes (0 = no RX buffer); only for a characteristic the client writes

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: 1 = a stream or the command binding can use it (an unframed characteristic with a way in or out)

fields.label: Provider id
fields.description: Its provider's id, for a stream's binding or the command binding; with Provider on

fields.label: Characteristic description
fields.description: Optional text description (0x2901), NUL-terminated, the last field

commands.label: Remove GATT characteristic
commands.description: Removes the given characteristic from its GATT service.

commands.label: Apply GATT changes
commands.description: Applies the staged GATT configuration to the BLE stack. With a client connected, it runs about 200 ms later, so this command is answered first; the client may reconnect.

commands.label: Read BLE status
commands.description: Returns the connection state, the negotiated MTU and the number of RX items dropped on a full buffer.

fields.label: Connected
fields.description: 1 = a client is connected, 0 = not connected

fields.label: Negotiated MTU
fields.description: The negotiated MTU in bytes

fields.label: Dropped RX items
fields.description: Number of peer writes dropped because an RX buffer was full

commands.label: Read GATT table
commands.description: Returns every service and characteristic in the GATT table, with their flags, TX and RX sizes and names.

returns.label: Table
returns.description: u8 service count; per service: u16 UUID, u8 flags, u8 characteristic count; per characteristic: u16 UUID, u8 flags, u32 tx, u32 rx, u8 provider (valid with its flag), name (NUL-terminated). The layout is described in SYS_BLE.MD.

commands.label: Scan for boards
commands.description: Looks for other runIT boards (their advertisement carries the runIT service) for a while, as a BLE central. The list of found boards is cleared first; FOUND reads it.

fields.label: Duration
fields.description: How long to scan, 100 to 30000 ms

commands.label: Read found boards
commands.description: The runIT boards the last scan found, and whether it still runs.

returns.label: Boards
returns.description: u8 scanning, u8 count; per board 24 B: u8 address type (0 public, 1 random), 6 B address (least significant byte first), i8 RSSI (dBm), 16 B name (NUL-padded). The layout is described in SYS_BLE.MD.

commands.label: Connect to a board
commands.description: Makes a provider that is a link to another board's runIT pair, as a BLE central: framed, up while connected; it connects again after every loss until the provider is removed (PROVIDER REMOVE). Attach a session to it as SLAVE.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The link's provider id

fields.label: Address type
fields.description: 0 public, 1 random

fields.label: Address, low
fields.description: The board's address, bytes 0 to 3 (least significant first)

fields.label: Address, high
fields.description: The board's address, bytes 4 and 5
